research_question: Which exact-form recurrences, repeated surface sequences, and cross-witness surface associations are mechanically prominent across all four Zarathustra parts without promoting a lemma, lexeme, translation equivalence, sign, concept, relation, or canon claim?

scope.german_whole_work_source: existing exact DTA lexical SQLite and tracked recurrence projection

normalization.exact_form: source-visible alphabetic token before analysis folding
normalization.russian_challenger_key: base key plus 1911 orthographic folding of yat, decimal-i, fita, izhitsa, and terminal hard sign
normalization.line_break_join: join only alphabetic line-end hyphen or not-sign with at least two letters on both sides before analysis tokenization
normalization.letterspacing_join: never join in the baseline; record runs of three or more one-letter tokens as layout-repair candidates
normalization.quality_gate: candidate identity universe uses the frozen half-one-letter ceiling; positive association metrics require every constituent paragraph to have at most one quarter one-letter exact tokens, content tokens, and no material mixed-script contamination

methods.global_recurrence_prominence: log1p(frequency) multiplied by 0.35 plus 0.65 times normalized four-part entropy
methods.keyword_stopword_posture: declared conservative function-word and pronoun filters; independent top-100 challenger shows stoplist sensitivity, so keyword means recurrence-prominence candidate only
methods.part_salience: smoothed part-versus-rest log odds multiplied by log1p(part frequency)
methods.repeated_sequences: all within-unit normalized 2- and 3-token sequences with at least three occurrences and at least one non-stopword token
methods.cross_language_association: alignment-unit support, bidirectional conditional precision, Dice, normalized PMI, strict one-to-one support, and ambiguous/deferred risk support

rollback: remove only this route, its builder, its focused test, and its ignored private parallel-lexical-candidates-v1 artifacts; no source witness, prior lexical projection, paragraph segmentation, or alignment packet is rewritten
authority_boundary: deterministic whole-work recurrence, repeated-sequence, and cross-witness surface-association candidates only; no accepted text, morphology, lemma, lexeme, sense, translation equivalence, sign, concept, relation, graph, canon, publication, or human review
